server_binding: Payload binding must equal the actual protected frame and committed recovery outcome. No Account/session identity or mutable policy is accepted from the response/request body as authority.
client_binding: Parent holds the expected owner request/operation/set/context/profile binding from StartChange; shared bootstrap holds stepUpRequestId. Require the original live view/controller/current operation immediately before the recovery-only synchronous consumer; discard on cancellation or stale receiver. Returned fields compared only to each other are insufficient.
native_metadata: Existing passkey requestId/attemptId/ceremonyId and current TOTP proof selection are preserved. Owner request ID and step-up/native IDs remain distinct.
safe_schemas: No first-delivery field in options/completed/reconciliation/original-result/cancel DTOs. Detect an unexpected field rather than silently dropping it as the current generic parsers do.
transport: Dedicated deferred IResult owns one serialization through finally, strict no-store/no-referrer and pre-write cancellation/binding validation. No later GET, escrow cookie, persisted plaintext or general DTO logging.

view_and_download.rule: One volatile view can display and request at most one optional local download from that same held payload. No automatic download, second fetch or repeat request. Requested/completed transfer does not assert human custody or saved/displayed receipt. Clear on close/unmount/departure.
